column1: # Phase 1: human docs into docs/<area>/ (tools/reorg/run_all.sh). Reviewed by hand: every
# docs/*.md is classified here, and phase1_docs.py STOPS on one that is not (the `check` line).
# Columns are TAB-separated. `stub` leaves a one-line "Moved to <new>" file at the old path,
# for links from outside the repo (artifacts, forums, GitHub blob URLs).
# Why every .md gets a stub, and the website's links do not need one: GitHub Pages will serve
# site/ (phase 3), where no .md exists at all, so a stub in docs/ could never answer a page
# link. The pages' .md links (TUTORIAL.html, ZIGMACHINE_GUIDE.html, rendered from the .md
# sources) are made absolute github.com/.../blob/main/docs/... URLs by tools/docgen instead
# docs/guide/: writing software for the machine
# docs/hardware/: the machine and the board
# docs/os/: KOS, GEM and the ROM
# docs/ports/: the three existing port notes stay where they are (phase 4 adds <tag>/ANALYSIS.md beside them)
# docs/hardware/studies/: the FPGA design studies and their evidence. fpga/review/tools/ is CODE and stays.
# fpga-relative mentions (code comments and READMEs under fpga/ say review/X.md): repo-rooted from now on
